title: Insights into pathogen inactivation and shelf-life extension of strawberries via combined ultrasound and levulinic acid treatment
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00926J, Paper
Open Access

Zifei Liu, Lingdai Liu, Zejia Lin, Fion Wei Lin Chin, Yuan Guo, Dan Li
This study investigated the bactericidal effects of levulinic acid (LVA) and ultrasound against Listeria monocytogenes and analysed the corresponding metabolic response posttreatment via nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy.
